entities.title: The rules, phase by phase
entities.summary: test/game.test.ts plays rooms through act() and tick() with a fixed clock and random source and checks each rule.
criteria: A game needs three connected players and only the host starts it; a start deals a topic, a secret, a stowaway and a clue order
Clues go in turn; the secret word itself is refused except from the stowaway; a turn, the vote and the guess each time out
Votes are not for oneself, may be changed, and close when everyone has voted
Each scoring case: caught and wrong, caught and right, a wrong accusation, a tie
The game runs its rounds and ends; a new game resets the scores
No topic repeats until all that fit are used, and the difficulty and child-friendly filters hold
Settings are host only, between games and in range; another player may take over once the host has been away; the host may not remove a player in the current round
Names are required, unique ignoring case and trimmed, and a room holds ten
Every real topic has 16 different words and a difficulty

checks.description: Seventeen node:test cases, one per criterion group above.

entities.title: Who sees the secret word and the stowaway
entities.summary: The secret word reaches only the players in the round who are not the stowaway, and nobody learns the stowaway before the reveal.
criteria: In a round, view() gives the secret to each player in it but the stowaway, and to no one who joined during it
Before the reveal, no view names the stowaway except the stowaway's own, and no view has the reveal or the accused while clues are given or votes cast
notChecked: That the reveal's view carries the secret, the stowaway, the votes and the points: no test reads the view at the reveal.

checks.symbol: only the players who should know it see the secret word, and nobody sees the stowaway before the reveal
a player who joins during a round waits for the next one and sees no secret
each socket gets its own view: the secret only for those allowed, and a second tab keeps a player connected
